targets.name: Külterületek
targets.reason: Primary municipal ITS/HEP confirms a statistical rural-planning group (Külterületek/puszták), including five detached puszta settlements. Its complete areal limit is not established by the available text/inset map; there is no name point. Individual named settlement footprints or all remaining municipal farmland would each silently change its meaning. No arbitrary residual municipality, circle, bounding box or small unrelated parcel is substituted.
